name: Proposal
description: One proposal sent to a client on a lead: what is offered and on which terms, how far it has got, the client's answer, and the copy that was sent and the signed copy as files. A revision is a new proposal that replaces the sent one.

global.schema:
type ProposalState {
  title: String
  code: String
  leadId: PHID
  recipient: Recipient
  contractingEntity: VaultRef
  currency: Currency
  validUntil: Date
  revisesProposalId: PHID
  bindingOnSignature: Boolean!
  processesPersonalData: Boolean!
  status: ProposalStatus!
  approvedBy: EthereumAddress
  approvedAt: DateTime
  sentBy: EthereumAddress
  sentAt: DateTime
  sentCopy: FileRef
  chosenOptionId: OID
  answeredAt: DateTime
  reason: String
  signedCopy: FileRef
  supersededByProposalId: PHID
  references: [Reference!]!
  packages: [Package!]!
  deliverables: [Deliverable!]!
  options: [Option!]!
  paymentSteps: [PaymentStep!]!
  actors: [Actor!]!
  useCases: [UseCase!]!
  boundaries: [Boundary!]!
  sections: [Section!]!
  clauses: [Clause!]!
  annexes: [Annex!]!
  figures: [Figure!]!
}

type Recipient {
  contactId: PHID!
  personId: OID
}

type VaultRef {
  id: PHID!
  title: String!
}

type FileRef {
  ref: AttachmentRef!
  name: String!
  type: String!
}

enum ProposalStatus {
  DRAFT
  APPROVED
  SENT
  ACCEPTED
  DECLINED
  WITHDRAWN
  SUPERSEDED
}

enum ReferenceKind {
  RESEARCH
  NOTE
  SOURCE
  COMPARABLE
  OPPORTUNITY
  LEAD
  DECISION
  OTHER
}

type Reference {
  id: OID!
  kind: ReferenceKind!
  documentId: PHID!
  title: String!
}

type Package {
  id: OID!
  code: String!
  name: String!
  summary: String
  requires: [OID!]!
  price: Amount_Money
  targetDate: Date
}

enum Pricing {
  FIXED
  INCLUDED
  RECURRING
  RATE
}

enum RecurringPeriod {
  MONTH
  QUARTER
  YEAR
}

enum RateUnit {
  HOUR
  DAY
}

type DeliverablePrice {
  pricing: Pricing!
  amount: Amount_Money
  upperAmount: Amount_Money
  period: RecurringPeriod
  unit: RateUnit
  until: Date
  note: String
}

type Deliverable {
  id: OID!
  code: String!
  packageId: OID!
  title: String!
  body: String
  price: DeliverablePrice
}

type Adjustment {
  id: OID!
  label: String!
  amount: Amount_Money!
  condition: String
}

type Option {
  id: OID!
  label: String!
  packageIds: [OID!]!
  adjustments: [Adjustment!]!
}

enum PaymentTrigger {
  ON_SIGNATURE
  ON_ACCEPTANCE
  ON_DATE
}

type PaymentStep {
  id: OID!
  label: String!
  trigger: PaymentTrigger!
  percentage: Amount_Percentage!
  date: Date
}

type Actor {
  id: OID!
  code: String!
  name: String!
  description: String
}

type UseCase {
  id: OID!
  code: String!
  actorId: OID!
  packageId: OID!
  title: String!
  body: String
}

enum BoundaryKind {
  ASSUMPTION
  CLIENT_INPUT
  EXCLUSION
  GUARANTEE
}

type Boundary {
  id: OID!
  kind: BoundaryKind!
  packageId: OID
  text: String!
  value: String
}

enum SectionKind {
  PROSE
  SCOPE
  ASSUMPTIONS
  DELIVERABLES
  PRICING
  SCHEDULE
  ACCEPTANCE
  TERMS
  ANNEXES
}

type Section {
  id: OID!
  kind: SectionKind!
  title: String
  body: String
  positioningId: OID
}

enum ClauseKind {
  CONTRACTING_PARTY
  LIABILITY
  CONFIDENTIALITY
  INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY
  TERMINATION
  GOVERNING_LAW
  FINAL_PROVISIONS
  OTHER
}

type Clause {
  id: OID!
  kind: ClauseKind!
  title: String!
  body: String
}

enum AnnexKind {
  DATA_PROCESSING
  FORM
  OTHER
}

type Annex {
  id: OID!
  kind: AnnexKind!
  title: String!
  body: String
  partOfAgreement: Boolean!
}

enum FigureAnchorKind {
  SECTION
  USE_CASE
}

type Figure {
  id: OID!
  anchorKind: FigureAnchorKind!
  anchorId: OID!
  file: FileRef!
  caption: String
}
